abstract: Ninety-three cases of germinal testicular tumors with urinary gonadotropin (HCG) values, estimated by biologic or radioimmunoassay techniques, were reviewed. Preoperative values of HCG and subsequent postoperative values were related to response to treatment and prognosis. Twenty-five patients (26.9 per cent) comprised the seminoma group, and 68 patients (73.1 per cent) the nonseminomatous groups of germinal neoplasms. High HCG values were observed in the nonseminomatous group pre- and postoperatively by both assay procedures. Most significant was the high HCG values postoperatively (p smaller than 0.05, x2 equals 5.21 and p smaller than 0.05, x2 equals 5.23) for the biologic assay and radioimmunoassay, respectively, with high HCG values being associated with a poor cumulative 24 per cent two-year survival rate. Urinary HCG assay is of prognostic value in the ongoing management of testicular neoplasms. In the future, serum HCG assays may be of additional benefit.
abstract_ja: 生物学的測定法または放射免疫測定法で尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が評価された胚細胞性精巣腫瘍93例を検討した。セミノーマ群は25例（26.9%）、非セミノーマ群は68例（73.1%）であった。非セミノーマ群では、両測定法とも術前・術後ともに高いhCG値が認められた。最も有意であったのは術後のhCG高値で、生物学的測定法（p<0.05, χ²=5.21）および放射免疫測定法（p<0.05, χ²=5.23）のいずれにおいても、hCG高値は2年累積生存率24%と不良な予後と関連していた。尿中hCG測定は精巣腫瘍の経過観察と予後判定に有用である。将来は血清hCG測定もさらに有用となる可能性がある。
